status: internally validated projection; not reader-outcome evidence

selection_checks.mode: exact current canonical delta from base volume paths

search_checks.execution: static in-browser; no server or alternate content authority

site_checks.product_authority: Lexicon canonical; Reader and Factor Guides are linked projections

composition_checks.mode: read-only exact trace inspection; no discovery or graph mutation

composition_lab_checks.mode: local bounded closure over explicit reviewed relation allowlist

composition_reading_checks.ordering: start, continue, evaluate; then title, destination, artifact
composition_reading_checks.deduplication: local destination with all artifact bindings retained

composition_palette_checks.readiness_inputs: explicit seeds, selected relation allowlist, direction

composition_starter_checks.relation_derivation: admitted edges plus exact budget-frontier relation IDs

composition_query_plan_checks.projection_input: visible explicit controls plus digest-bound payloads

composition_reconciliation_checks.projection_input: identified local result plus digest-bound payloads
composition_reconciliation_checks.partition: exhaustive and disjoint over selected controls

composition_continuation_checks.projection_input: identified local result plus digest-bound payloads
composition_continuation_checks.application: one explicit control edit per activation

composition_rerun_comparison_checks.projection_input: previous and current identified local results plus exact applied continuation actions
composition_rerun_comparison_checks.retention: one pending source and one consumed comparison in page memory
composition_rerun_comparison_checks.comparison_identity: none; inherits previous and current result SHA-256

composition_guide_skeleton_checks.projection_input: identified local result plus digest-bound lab and reading payloads
composition_guide_skeleton_checks.placement: after closure map and before canonical reading route

composition_evaluation_record_checks.projection_input: identified local result plus explicit user-declared check records
composition_evaluation_record_checks.placement: after Factor Guide Skeleton and before canonical reading route
composition_evaluation_record_checks.identity: separate SHA-256 over canonical evaluation JSON; bound to result SHA-256
